strings.name: Omar Sy
strings.summary: Raised in a West African immigrant family in France, Sy moved from radio and comedy with Fred Testot into cinema. The Intouchables brought a César and international attention; Samba and Chocolat extended roles on migration and Black performance history. Lupin broadened his global audience and his creative production responsibilities.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: The Intouchables and Lupin expand the international visibility of Afro-French actors in mainstream culture.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth and upbringing
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Trappes, France, in 1978 to West African parents.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Began at Radio Nova after high school and developed comedy with Testot.

strings.highlights.h2.title: International reach
